headline: Trump’s threat to strike Iran raises public concerns, congressional questions
description: <p>WASHINGTON: President Donald Trump has renewed his threat of military action against Iran, raising questions about public support for the war and <a href="https://www.dawn.com/news/2035790">Congress’s ability to restrain further escalation</a>.</p> <p>With <a href="https://www.dawn.com/news/2038966">midterm elections</a> approaching on November 3, polls show widespread <a href="https://www.dawn.com/news/2031648">dissatisfaction with the war</a>, particularly over rising fuel prices and the risk to American troops. headline: Israel launches major West Bank operation after soldiers killed

headline: Tropical Storm Champi nears China after battering Taiwan, Japan
description: <p>A powerful storm swept towards China on Saturday after battering Taiwan and Japan’s southernmost islands, knocking out power to thousands of households and forcing the cancellation of hundreds of flights.</p> <p>Typhoon Champi was downgraded to a tropical storm as its wind speed dropped to 102 kilometres (63 miles) per hour, according to the latest update from the Joint Typhoon Warning Centre.</p> <p>Taiwanese authorities evacuated more than 5,000 people from their homes ahead of the storm, which toppled trees, brought down power lines and triggered brief flood
imageAlt: Tropical Storm Champi nears China after battering Taiwan, Japan

headline: Haris Rauf calls for middle-over breakthroughs as ODI scores soar
description: <p>One-day International cricket has gone through changes over the years, but one of the aspects of the game that has continued to be crucial is the importance of taking wickets in the middle overs.</p> <p>In the span of the last three years, which included Pakistan’s dismal 2023 World Cup campaign in India, the national side’s bowlers have struggled to strike as often as they would have liked in the middle overs.</p> <p>Haris Rauf, who has featured for Pakistan in most of the matches through this period, is well aware of the team’s shortcomings as they look forwa
imageAlt: Haris Rauf calls for middle-over breakthroughs as ODI scores soar

headline: France to deploy 70,000 police for fresh weekend protests
description: <p>France will deploy about 70,000 police nationwide as it braces for new protests on Saturday after some of the worst urban violence in years erupted on the sidelines of demonstrations a week ago.</p> <p>Protests by high school students over learning conditions sparked a movement that has since spread nationwide, fuelled by broader anger over the rising cost of living.</p> <p>About 70,000 security personnel will be deployed on Saturday, Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said at a news conference in Paris, warning that calls for violence and looting were circulating
imageAlt: France to deploy 70,000 police for fresh weekend protests

headline: Section 144 imposed in Upper, Lower South Waziristan over security concerns
description: <p>SOUTH WAZIRISTAN: The district administrations of Lower and Upper South Waziristan imposed Section 144 restrictions for Saturday, restricting movement in several areas and closing markets and major routes amid security concerns and the movement of logistical supplies for security forces.</p> <p>Lower South Waziristan Deputy Commissioner Musarrat Zaman and Upper South Waziristan Deputy Commissioner Irfan Ali issued separate notifications on Friday evening, outlining restrictions on public movement, access to designated roads and other activities in the affected areas.</p
imageAlt: Section 144 imposed in Upper, Lower South Waziristan over security concerns

headline: Fire breaks out at Hitler's mountain retreat, suspect detained: police
description: <p>German police said Saturday they had detained a suspect following a fire at Adolf Hitler’s mountain retreat, known as the Eagle’s Nest, in the state of Bavaria.</p> <p>Around 200 firefighters were deployed to tackle the blaze at the Nazi dictator’s remote Kehlsteinhaus residence, on the peak of Obersalzberg in southern Germany.</p> <p>Firefighters saw flames rising high into the air as they approached the scene, only to find the building “completely ablaze”, police said.</p> <figure class='media w-full w-full media-- media--embed media--uneven media--t
imageAlt: Fire breaks out at Hitler's mountain retreat, suspect detained: police

headline: UAE diplomat vying for UN's top job
description: <p>An Emirati official with Palestinian roots, Lana Nusseibeh has emerged as a late frontrunner in the race to lead the United Nations, campaigning on a reformist agenda and vowing to work for peace.</p> <p>Since her official nomination on Wednesday, she has already garnered the backing of Gulf states but also faced scrutiny over her country’s normalisation with Israel and Abu Dhabi’s alleged role in Sudan’s war.</p> <p>If she succeeds, she would be the first woman and the second Arab to snatch the job in what would be a tour de force for the United Arab Emirates
imageAlt: UAE diplomat vying for UN's top job
